message.text: rg is unavailable, so I will use grep instead.

The memo lifecycle events that dispatch webhooks have been identified.

Created → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (`memos.memo.created`)
Updated → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (`memos.memo.updated`)
Deleted → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (`memos.memo.deleted`)
Comment created → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (`memos.memo.comment.created`)

All converge on `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. Workers call `Post` for actual delivery.

Created, updated, and deleted webhooks route through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` first. Only comment created calls `webhook.PostAsync` directly.
I'll confirm there are no other memo webhook dispatchers besides the four in `memo_service_webhooks.go`.
Searching recursively for webhook dispatch functions and delivery paths.

A leftover comment was found at memo_service.go:603.

The three memo lifecycle events that dispatch webhooks are created, updated, and deleted. Their dispatch functions are DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook, DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook, and DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook. These converge at the delivery function.

A fourth event, comment created, dispatches via DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook. All four lifecycle events converge at webhook.PostAsync in webhook/webhook.go.

q30.
created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
comment created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook
webhook.PostAsync (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`)

These four dispatchers live in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. Created/updated/deleted go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` first; comment created calls `webhook.PostAsync` directly. All four converge on `webhook.PostAsync`, which queues payloads for `webhook.Post` HTTP delivery.
